meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.Internal.Row: The square-integrability requirement uses radial weight p.1; it is not an unweighted L2 assumption.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.crossVec: This is the physical real cross product; the same leaf name in the row torus module denotes a different, packed-profile coupling vector.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonic: Integer division alone does not guarantee recovery of an arbitrary frequency pair; the related proposition includes the required parity hypothesis.
The transform includes a minus sign, so the complex harmonic lift uses cosine plus i times this negative-sine component.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.KeyConjInternal.poten: The chosen potential is defined to be zero when no potential exists. This default does not prove that an arbitrary vector field is a gradient.
notes.Breakdown.CertCell.RealLabelZeroInternal: The chosen potential of the zero field may be an arbitrary almost-everywhere constant. Subtracting its ball average is the step that removes this freedom.
